law: Use Wi-Fi Infrastructure to automatically share Wi-Fi network credentials after establishing a Bluetooth connection.
Companion apps that have paired an accessory with can use the Wi-Fi™️ Infrastructure framework to share networks with their paired accessory over a local Bluetooth 4.2 Secure connection.

Use this framework to avoid manually entering network passwords on accessories with limited input capabilities, such as smartwatches, Internet of Things (IoT) devices, or other connected hardware that travels with people across different networks.
People using your app must have an account registered in the European Union (EU), and their device must be located within the EU.
